minutes.headline: Select Board endorsed GW Shaw as new trash hauler and reprogrammed ARPA funds, both unanimously.
minutes.summary: The board heard public comment on staff turnover and the recall effort, then took up the trash and recycling contract, a business-community update, earth removal renewals and two staff appointments. It reprogrammed ARPA allocations and began a first discussion of FY25 board goals without finalizing them. It also discussed the Flat Hill Road speed limit and the special town meeting warrant.

public_comment.topic: Staff turnover tied to poorly documented procedures and hard-to-find information; urged written SOPs and training on tools like SharePoint.
Update on the recall effort, objection to personal attacks, and questions about a claimed tax deferral deal and a claimed savings to the town.
Said she was intimidated by a man at the previous meeting after speaking in support of the recall.

Make five ARPA reprogramming changes, including funding the Historical Society tree removal.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to endorse a three-year trash and recycling contract with GW Shaw.
The interim town manager is to give the board the final trash contract before it is signed.
The board voted unanimously to make five ARPA reprogramming changes, including funding the Historical Society tree removal.
The board ratified two staff appointments, a Conservation Commission assistant and a land use director, and renewed two earth removal permits, all unanimously.
A first discussion of FY25 board goals ended without a resolution, and the interim town manager is to bring Flat Hill Road speed options next Tuesday.

why_it_matters: The trash and recycling contract sets what the town pays for curbside service for three years, and the final terms were still to be shown to the board after the vote.
ARPA money is fully allocated, so a request for a share of a small-towns website cost has to be funded from another source, which could mean a future transfer or warrant article.
watch_next: The final GW Shaw contract, which the interim town manager is to give the board before signing.
The Flat Hill Road speed report and signage options, due at next Tuesday's meeting.
